thread.title: Transgender Miss Maine Contestant Will Face Off Against Bill Belichick's Girlfriend Jordon Hudson
thread.title_full: Transgender Miss Maine Contestant Will Face Off Against Bill Belichick's Girlfriend Jordon Hudson

author: Rudiger Sampson
text:
Trans folks have existed throughout history. A simple google search can confirm this. It's gaining popularity now because of movements throughout the 20th century. So, it's not going anywhere even with this administration. Sorry to burst your bubble. Maybe folks that would have transitioned will now accept their pain. But gender dysphoria is not new and will not go away.
This is very similar to when we tried to force children not to be left-handed. After that stopped, the perecentage of folks being left-handed rose to a certain level and then tappered off. Same thing will happen with the trans community.
Here's a fun stat. Of the 500,000 NCAA athletes, 10 identify as trans. This is occurring in an environment that you say is pushing children to transition. Good luck getting that 10 down to 0 and I'm glad you're spending so much money and attention on this issue.
